changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[FieldDetailsByAssetId] ( @AssetID bigint, @FieldTypeId int, @AllowAllValue bit, @HasDefaultValue bit ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN @AllowAllValue = 1 AND F.[Value] = '0' THEN T.AllowAllLabel WHEN F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN F.FormattedValue WHEN @HasDefaultValue = 1 THEN T.DefaultFormattedValue ELSE NULL END AS nvarchar(MAX)) AS FormattedValue FROM dbo.FieldType AS T LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Field AS F ON F.FieldTypeID = @FieldTypeId and F.AssetId = @AssetID WHERE T.id = @FieldTypeId )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[FieldDetailsByAssetId] ( @AssetID bigint, @FieldTypeId int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT CASE WHEN T.AllowAllValue = 1 AND F.[Value] = '0' THEN CAST(T.AllowAllLabel AS nvarchar(MAX)) WHEN F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN F.FormattedValue WHEN T.DefaultFormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(T .DefaultFormattedValue AS nvarchar(MAX)) ELSE NULL END AS FormattedValue FROM dbo.FieldType AS T LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Field AS F ON F.AssetId = @AssetID and F.FieldTypeID = T.ID WHERE t.id = @FieldTypeId and ((F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL AND F.FormattedValue <> '') OR T.DefaultValue IS NOT NULL OR T.ShowIfEmpty = 1 )
